title: Ann's Additions
description: This was mostly made for myself, and is mainly just a collection of blocks.
body:
**--THIS MOD WAS MADE MOSTLY JUST FOR MYSELF!!!--**

Howdy hey! Welcome to my epic mod page!! This is my first mod, and it is really simple. It will mostly just contain different building blocks, likely mainly concrete, but I may add more advanced blocks later on. I hope that if you decide to use this you enjoy it!!

Things added so far:
- Concrete tile,
- Concrete stairs,
- Chain linked fences,
- Barbed wire,
- Neon blocks,
- Painted concrete. (white and yellow)

Things I plan to add:
- More concrete and brutalist type blocks,
- Automation stuff,
- Mobility stuff.
